run_doctest_slice: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python slice argument resolution and index computation
test_accept_slice: test that accept_slice correctly resolves a slice object and rejects non-slice arguments
test_check_slice_get_indices: test check_slice_get_indices with various slice parameters including negative steps and bounds
test_check_string_rich_slice: test extended slicing operations on string objects for Python 2.3 and later versions
run_module_as_main: run the slice test module directly to execute all doctests and print pass or fail status
